# TP53 - disgenet 
## DisGeNET 
 
**DisGeNET status (DisGeNET):** unavailable; no conclusion can be drawn — DisGeNET gene associations are unavailable.
Retry: `biomcp get gene TP53 disgenet` 
More:
  biomcp get gene TP53 pathways   - Reactome/KEGG pathway context

  biomcp search article -g TP53
  biomcp search drug --target TP53
